name: Beijing Emerging Eastern Aviation Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Emerging Eastern Aviation Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture and sale of airborne equipment and supporting equipment. It offers airborne suspension, transmitting devices and aircraft information devices, aircraft management & recording systems, comprehensive testing & support systems and military autonomous controllable computers. Its products are used in aviation, ships, weapons and other equipment fields. The company was founded on June 16, 1997 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
